name: PriceChannel_Signal_v2 EA
summary: This EA trades based on Price Channel breakouts, generating buy signals when price breaks above the upper channel boundary and sell signals when price breaks below the lower channel boundary. It uses the Donchian-style channel (highest high/lowest low over a lookback period) to define dynamic support and resistance levels. The v2 version adds signal filtering and alert capabilities to improve entry quality.
summary_zh: 该EA基于价格通道突破进行交易，当价格突破通道上轨时产生买入信号，当价格跌破通道下轨时产生卖出信号。它使用唐奇安式通道（回溯周期内的最高价和最低价）来定义动态支撑和阻力位。v2版本增加了信号过滤和提醒功能以提高入场质量。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是价格通道突破系统，类似于唐奇安通道指标，通过计算一定周期内的最高价和最低价构建上下轨通道。入场条件为：当价格收盘价突破上轨时开多单，当价格收盘价跌破下轨时开空单。出场条件通常依赖反向突破信号或固定的止损止盈设置，部分版本可能加入追踪止损功能。仓位管理方面，该EA支持固定手数交易，部分参数允许根据账户余额动态调整仓位大小。资金管理上，止损通常设置在通道对侧边界，具有合理的风险回报比。策略的改进版v2加入了信号确认机制，避免在通道宽度收窄时产生虚假突破信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a price channel breakout system, similar to the Donchian Channel indicator, which constructs upper and lower boundaries by calculating the highest high and lowest low over a specified lookback period. Entry conditions are: a buy position is opened when the closing price breaks above the upper channel boundary, and a sell position is opened when the closing price breaks below the lower channel boundary. Exit conditions typically rely on reverse breakout signals or fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels, with some versions potentially incorporating a trailing stop mechanism. For position sizing, the EA supports fixed lot trading, and some parameters allow dynamic lot adjustment based on account balance. In terms of money management, stop-losses are generally placed at the opposite channel boundary, providing a reasonable risk-reward ratio. The improved v2 version adds a signal confirmation mechanism to avoid false breakout signals when the channel width narrows.

parameters.description: 价格通道计算周期，用于确定最高价和最低价的回溯K线数量
parameters.description_en: Price channel period for highest/lowest lookback bars

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points per level, 0 for none

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points per level

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop activation distance in points

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于标识本EA的订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for order identification

parameters.name: SignalFilter
parameters.description: 是否启用信号过滤，避免虚假突破
parameters.description_en: Enable signal filter to avoid false breakouts

pros: 通道突破策略逻辑清晰，易于理解和参数优化
动态通道边界能自适应市场波动，在趋势行情中表现良好
v2版本增加信号过滤功能，减少虚假突破导致的亏损交易
pros_en: Channel breakout strategy logic is clear and easy to understand with straightforward parameter optimization
Dynamic channel boundaries adapt to market volatility, performing well in trending markets
The v2 version adds signal filtering to reduce losing trades from false breakouts
cons: 在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假突破信号，导致连续亏损
固定止损止盈未考虑ATR等波动率指标，在不同市场条件下可能不适用
缺乏多时间周期确认机制，仅依赖单一周期的通道判断
cons_en: Prone to frequent false breakout signals in ranging markets, leading to consecutive losses
Fixed stop-loss and take-profit don't account for ATR or volatility indicators, which may be unsuitable under varying market conditions
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation, relying solely on single-timeframe channel assessment
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动率自适应调整止损距离
加入多时间周期确认机制，要求高一级时间周期趋势方向一致才开仓
增加通道宽度过滤，当通道过窄时暂停交易以避免震荡行情中的虚假突破
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit to adapt stop distances based on market volatility
Implement multi-timeframe confirmation, requiring higher timeframe trend alignment before opening positions
Add channel width filtering to pause trading when the channel is too narrow, avoiding false breakouts in sideways markets

risk_points: 固定止损未考虑市场波动率变化，在剧烈波动时可能止损过近导致被扫
缺乏持仓检查机制可能导致重复开仓
震荡行情中虚假突破可能造成连续亏损
risk_points_en: Fixed stop-loss doesn't account for volatility changes, potentially getting stopped out too close during high volatility
Lack of position check mechanism may lead to duplicate entries
False breakouts in ranging markets can cause consecutive losses
